result: {"p": 0.42, "rationale": "A 100k+ acre fall/winter California fire signals extreme fire weather, but most very large acreage fires burn in sparsely populated wildlands with modest insured losses; reaching USD 2bn requires significant urban conflagration (as in 2017-18 and 2025 events), which occurs in a substantial but minority fraction of such seasons, with a modest additional chance from a separate qualifying earthquake or other wildfire."}
